metadata.description: Shim marketplace. cursor/plugins ships .cursor-plugin/marketplace.json, which Codex reads and Claude Code does not. This file re-declares the same plugins in the schema Claude Code understands, and pulls each one straight from the upstream repository with git-subdir. Nothing is vendored, so an upstream release arrives with `claude plugin update`.
